preconditions.description: The number of elements n, maximum operations k, and step value x are positive integers.
The input array a contains exactly n integers.
Each element in the input array has an absolute value not exceeding 10^9.

postconditions.description: The output array b contains exactly n integers.

postconditions.expression: all((b[i] - a[i]) % x == 0 for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: For every element, the difference between the output and input is a multiple of x, preserving the modulo x invariant.

postconditions.expression: sum(abs(b[i] - a[i]) // x for i in range(n)) <= k
postconditions.description: The total number of operations applied (sum of absolute differences divided by x) does not exceed k.

postconditions.expression: prod_b == min(prod_c for c in valid_configs)
postconditions.description: The product of elements in b is the minimum possible product among all arrays reachable from a using at most k operations, where valid_configs represents all arrays satisfying the modulo and operation count constraints.
